summary: Require verified subject provenance before canonical-self binding.
details: Merge commit abb1f10ada2eabc0ed63f8c085b7357b37019342 carries episode-scoped subject provenance through extraction and repair, validates the exact current-episode endpoint before canonical binding, and preserves UUID and graph state on rollback. Production already runs canonical-self binding in enforce mode, so the release must exercise the active automatic-memory path.
operator_impact: Keep the existing enforce mode and run the release-bound synthetic canary. Existing fork cleanup remains a separate operator-only migration under the documented census and rehearsal gates.
